content.value: A boiler is equipment with a chimney of32m height. The flue gases which pass through 11 the chimney are at temperature of 290°C, whereas the atmospheric temperature is 22°C. If the air flow through the combustion chamber is 18 kg/kg of fuel brunt, find:
(i) The theoretical draught produced in mm of water and in height of hot gases column, and
(ii) Velocity of flue gases passing through the chimney, if 50% of theoretical draught is lost in friction at the grate and passage.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
